title: Nameless Masters, Westward
narration_slice: to mortal will in the eastern darkness. Legend claims these nameless masters journeyed westward to the smoking peaks of the Valyrian peninsula, brought tamed dragons or binding lore to the silver-haired herdsmen, taught them their arcane arts, and then vanished utterly from the history of men.
locations: the Shadow breaking west (0471-0473); the Valyrian peninsula, first sight (0474-0476); the herdsmen (0477-0480)
creature_refs: DRG-VAL-001 appears twice - 0470 as a bent head in the Shadow, 0476 as a strict silhouette
the_legend_rule: This batch is the legend itself, spoken as legend. Nothing may be staged as historical fact: the masters are never seen clearly and never speak, the gift is never explained, and the dragons are shown as pre-existing rather than as discoveries. The narration hedges with 'Legend claims' and the images must hedge the same way.
the_westward_crossing: The single biggest visual idea in the batch is the light change: out of the Shadow's sourceless grey-green gloom into the first real daylight of the episode - flat, cold, overcast, colourless, and never golden. 0474 is the hinge frame: the four figures come over the pass and the world has a sun in it again, without drama.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 35mm lateral track: three robed figures walk west across the pass, each head so deeply bowed that the hood hangs past the crown and the whole head is a black fold of cloth. No face, no profile, no mask plane on any of them; sleeves hide the hands, hems ragged and grey with ash. The middle figure is taller and a pace nearer. Flat gloom, feet lost in ash haze, a weak rim of pale mist behind them the only separation from the rock. Movement without urgency, anonymity without performance. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 65mm long-lens compression on two pairs of hands and the object between them: a length of heavy heat-cured dark leather strap, worn smooth and black at the edges, with a plain iron ring worked through one end and no buckle, no stud, no device. Ash worked into the creases of both pairs of hands. The heads and faces of both figures are entirely out of frame above. One dull blood-red glow from the right picks a sheen off the leather and the ring. Nothing stamped, branded, dyed or marked anywhere - the object is only ever a tool. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 50mm from just behind and slightly above: four robed figures at the top of a scree slope with their backs to camera, hoods low, shoulders bowed, looking out at a paler distance where the Shadow finally breaks. One has a hand raised slightly - not gesturing, just resting in the air. Ahead of them the mist thins and there is the first suggestion of a different colour, cold grey, not yet a landscape. The last frame in which they are entirely of the Shadow. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 35mm from behind and above a high pass, looking into the smoking peaks of the Valyrian peninsula for the first time. Three bare black cones in the middle distance, summits torn, each trailing a thin dark smoke plume bent steadily west. Below them dry ash-grey slopes give way to folds of dark cypress and olive. The Summer Sea as a hard cold band at the far edge. The four figures stand at the lip, small, seen from behind, hoods and hems moving in the wind. **Overcast daylight at last** - flat, cold, colourless, no golden hour, no sun disc, no god-light. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 24mm from a shoulder of a northern peak: the peninsula laid out from height, a crescent of fourteen cones running away south-west, the far ones pale grey in the haze and the three nearest black with torn summits. Ash-grey slopes feed emerald valleys - dark cypress, wild olive, pasture too small to be built. Smoke stands off every cone and is dragged sideways by high wind. The Summer Sea holds the whole left edge under flat overcast. **Nothing human is visible: no town, no road, no wall, no herd, no figure.** This is the land before anyone is named in it. Reframed 0-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.shot_type: 24mm towering vertical composition: the dragon in strict silhouette on black scree
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED on image integrity, not on content. There is a **hard vertical seam at x=657 running the full height of the frame**, with the left third rendered as a separate darker exposure with its own edge - a panorama-stitch artifact. It cannot be cropped out: the seam sits between the foreground rock and the dragon, and any crop that removes it removes either the animal or the figures. The dragon silhouette itself is exactly right (four limbs, two folded wings, two planted hind legs, twin horns breaking the outline) and so is the composition, which is why this is a re-render and not a rethink.
scenes.rerender_brief: Repeat the same shot and composition - 24mm from low on the scree, the dragon in strict profile silhouette against a pale ash slope, three tiny figures at the bottom edge - but render it as ONE continuous photograph. Negate: panorama, stitched image, collage, split panel, triptych, vertical seam, differing exposure, border, frame within frame, matte. State that it is a single continuous photographic exposure from corner to corner, with even lighting across the whole frame and no vertical divisions of any kind.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 85mm macro at the root of a dragon's horn where it meets the skull: black ridged keratin sweeping out of frame, dry overlapping coal-black skull plates edged with a faint dull bronze where the scale has worn, a coarse dark leather strap drawn tight across the horn's root, worn smooth and cracked with age. **No stamp, no brand, no dye, no rune, no device on the leather.** A single pale human hand enters lower left and rests two fingers flat against the horn's root without gripping. Ash dust in every groove; flat cool light so the blacks stay black. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 85mm at standing height: a young Valyrian shepherd close, three-quarter from behind and to the side, the face mostly in shadow as he looks up and away at something out of frame. Weather-worn, high flat cheekbones, a wind-burnt nose, ash dust in the creases. Long loose silver-white hair, unplaited, blown across one cheek and caught behind the ear. Coarse undyed wool mantle over a darker tunic, the shoulder seam hand-sewn and mended twice. **No ornament, no ring, no clasp, no mark of rank** - a herdsman, never a chosen one, and the flat overcast light refuses to make him look like one. Full-bleed.
